              raise SystemExit("protected_harness_revision_unreviewed")

          RUNNER_TEMP: ${{ runner.temp }}

      - name: Set up the official artifact bridge runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Install the lockfile-pinned official artifact client
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/trusted-review-harness/scripts/actions-artifact-uploader
        env:
          ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN: ''
          ACTIONS_RESULTS_URL: ''
          ACTIONS_RUNTIME_URL: ''
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Run the protected publication runtime
        uses: groktopus/codereview/scripts/protected-publication-action@04c7fc0b42221872e6c6b611be91c68e462fc679
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PYTHONPATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/trusted-review-harness/src
